classificationNote: Every entry below is a research LEAD, not a conclusion. None asserts an OKX x Kazakhstan availability, KYC, registration, ranking, CTA, promo or eligibility status. Retrieval dates are the intake-preparation reference dates from the repository, not live re-verification. The Deep Research run must independently retrieve, date and tier each source.
globalOverInferenceWarnings: Absence of Kazakhstan from a restricted-country list is a partial positive signal, not proof of availability.
A visible KZT/P2P surface is a product signal, not proof of account or legal eligibility.
An AFSA warning is a regulatory signal, not by itself proof of technical unavailability.
The OKX Europe Limited MiCA CASP license (EEA) is not evidence about Kazakhstan.
Repository routes, codes and bonus figures are implementation facts, not eligibility evidence.
Historical campaigns are not proof of current eligibility.
